title: Scaffold the VTT procedural-generation test/visualization surface in apps/architecture-studio: a real (minimal) Rust/Wasm domain crate, rendered via Three.js inside a GridLayout panel
objective: Continues the owner-approved plan (C:\Users\PICHAU\.claude\plans\mellow-drifting-nova.md, Phase C step 2-3) after VTT-WASM-COMPILE-VERIFICATION-SPIKE confirmed all four candidate crates compile to wasm32-unknown-unknown. Per ADR-0016 (Accepted, DEC-054) surface 2 and its Follow-up work item 3, this task promotes a small, real (not toy) subset of that spike into an actual Rust domain crate wired into apps/architecture-studio, and adds a new route rendering its real output via Three.js inside @grafting/ui's GridLayout -- the first real GridLayout consumer, per packages/ui/DECISIONS.md's addendum. Scope is deliberately minimal: one real noise-backed heightmap generation function, not the full Townscaper-style WFC pipeline (tileset authoring, terrain/water passes remain explicitly out of scope per the plan and ADR-0016's own Follow-up work sequencing, items 3's 'real domain crate' promotion is scoped here to a small first slice, not the complete pipeline).
validations: PENDING: new crate scaffolded via tools/scripts/generate-rust-crate.mjs, then hand-extended with wasm-bindgen/cdylib wiring (generator has none) mirroring libs/isekai/wasm-bridge's Cargo.toml shape; cargo check/test pass natively.
PENDING: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown and wasm-pack build --target web succeed for the new crate.
PENDING: packages/vtt-generation-wasm npm wrapper mirrors packages/isekai-wasm's package.json shape.

PENDING: apps/architecture-studio's copy-wasm-assets.mjs extended to also copy this new package's pkg/ output as a static asset; the new route's worker loads it via the same webpackIgnore-guarded runtime-URL pattern already proven for the Graph IR layout worker and spikes/wasm-worker-nextjs.
PENDING: new /vtt-generation route renders real Wasm-computed heightmap output via Three.js inside one @grafting/ui GridLayout panel; tsc --noEmit and next build both pass.
PENDING: docs-generate re-run for both the new Rust crate and architecture-studio, per root AGENTS.md's completion rule.
risks: Owner correction mid-task: importing `three` directly into apps/architecture-studio broke this repo's own established DEC-049/ADR-0011 and DEC-052/ADR-0014 pattern (third-party runtime libraries stay behind a Grafting-owned package boundary -- @antv/x6 behind packages/x6-canvas, antd behind packages/ui). Fixed by adding a new packages/three-canvas package exposing a neutral createHeightfieldCanvas(container, options) mechanism; no THREE.* type appears in its public surface. apps/architecture-studio now depends on @grafting/three-canvas instead of three directly.

This crate's own directory needs no [workspace] opt-out (unlike the throwaway spikes/ crates) because libs/ crates are meant to join the real root Cargo.toml workspace -- confirmed consistent with every existing libs/ crate.

Scope deliberately minimal (one heightmap function) -- the real Townscaper-style generation pipeline (tileset authoring, WFC passes, terrain/water) remains explicitly out of scope, per the approved plan and ADR-0016's own Follow-up work sequencing.

No dependency added without evaluation: noise/getrandom versions and the wasm-pack/static-asset pattern all match what VTT-WASM-COMPILE-VERIFICATION-SPIKE and ARCH-STUDIO-NEXTJS-MIGRATION already verified working.
